integrity: All-parameter proof through actual integral relative chains, the nerve lemma, combinatorial Alexander duality, and published integral higher-independence homotopy results; finite tests are corroboration rather than certification.
scientific_limitations: The result gives reduced integral homology groups for full strong cycle complexes with n>=6, not their homotopy type, dihedral representations, cohomology products, or canonical splitting; possible unindexed equivalent proofs remain a literature risk.
title: Uniform integral homology of full strong Morse matching complexes of cycles
